**Finding: compliant (preferred).**

The Agreement contains only one most-favoured-nation mechanic and it benefits us: § 6 (p0047) obliges TrueLink to hold Hosting Services costs flat for one year and to charge us rates no higher than those charged to any other party. There is no reciprocal obligation on Mortgage Logic.com to extend TrueLink terms given to other hosts or partners, and no right-to-match or best-offer disclosure mechanic anywhere in the document (checked § 2 licence, § 5–6 compensation, § 8 Client covenants, plus targeted searches for MFN-style phrasing).

This satisfies the preferred position — no Customer MFN obligation benefiting Vendor — so no redline was proposed, and the Vendor-granted MFN in § 6 should be retained as drafted.
